driver: The decisive move is conditioning a randomized holdout's measured treatment effect on each unit's own prior treatment history, rebuilt only by grouping the treatment log per unit, because the target pool's mix on that axis differs from the measurement corpus, so a correct stratum-level effect misprices and misallocates a capped budget.
driver_concrete: Grouping the offer log per reader (and replaying the queue rule for holdout members) splits each band's 90-day return into first-qualification cells (+6.64 / +19.45 / -1.05) and re-qualified cells that measure nothing; June's B2 is 73 of 177 re-qualified against about one in six in the corpus, so the 200 sends go 104 B2 + 96 B1 for 26.6 stops.
stump: A competent solver rebuilds the queue, differences offered against held-out within each reporting band on closed windows and files the band-cell fill, all 177 of B2 plus 23 from B1 at 31.7 stops, because it never splits the cells by the reader's own programme history, which exists only by grouping the offer log per reader.
